name: js-ts-frontend-evidence
body: Verified this session: the TypeScript frontend is plain JavaScript ESM (src/tslib/scanner.mjs, package.json "type": "module", sole dep typescript@5.9.3, no build step); it scans only .ts/.tsx (allowJs: false) and always skips node_modules, so src/tslib yields an apg-tsfrontend module node and zero symbols. APG cannot scan JavaScript repos at all. This is the cheapest frontend to extend because JS is a subset the TypeScript compiler already handles via allowJs. Source: code graph + source read. verified.
